resolution: Extended the painted-tile facade approach per the user's ask for fake entryways, storefront variety, and wall props. Board I / Facades gained 3 materials in cart/hmsc-int/render3d/fillShader.ts: brick_entrance (stone-surround door + transom light + coach lamp + upper window; Stoop/Recessed/Glazed Double Door), brick_rollshutter (closed corrugated shutter with graffiti tags; Plain/Tagged/Graffitied), and brick_bodega (open corner-store with barred glass, side door, striped awning, neon sign bar; Bodega/Laundromat/Diner). A new Board J / Wall Props (board id 9) adds five mounted street-furniture materials, each rendered over its own brick-apartment background so the tile is one opaque face: wall_flag (a swaying hung banner), wall_plants (window boxes / hanging vines / climbing ivy via shared leaf_cover+leaf_color helpers), wall_billboard (poster/faded/torn with light bar + struts), wall_sign (blade / vertical neon / wooden shingle), and wall_ac (window AC / louvered vent / conduit+meter). Boards 8 and 9 are wired through the fs_main dispatch, quality_pass (kept crisp), the editor texture catalog (hmsc-int/game/textures/shaders.ts) so each appears as a pickable, seed/detail-grade-tunable shader, and the effect_fills eval cart for parity. All three files transpile clean; no unary-plus WGSL violations; helper declaration order verified. User runs the build to view.
